title: Bank balance series
description: The end-of-day balances of a bank account the member views, one per UTC day of the requested period, with the balance target. Foreign bank data: a client keeps it in memory only, for at most 7 days.

points.description: One point per UTC day, oldest first.

balance.description: The balance at the end of the day in whole aUEC.

balanceTarget.description: The balance goal in whole aUEC; null when none is set.
